0022600028.text: This is the 9th game of the season for the Utah Jazz, who are 1-7 and have lost six straight, including all three road games, while the Dallas Mavericks are 4-4 and have dropped their last two. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Max Christie (hip), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet this season, and their 2025-26 series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on January 17 in Dallas, where the Jazz lost 138-120.
